title: TransferEdge
description: One typed relationship occurrence from a source record to a version-pinned destination, before native owner promotion.

id.description: Opaque immutable identity of the relationship occurrence.

job_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve within the same Institution and exact approved job or resource generation as described.

plan_revision.description: Frozen plan revision containing the source and any local target.

from_record_id.description: Source record in the same frozen plan.
from_record_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve within the same Institution and exact approved job or resource generation as described.

edge_key.description: Adapter-owned exact semantic relationship occurrence key within the source record. Distinct from a display label or target ID.

kind.description: Typed owner projection relationship. An ordinary hyperlink cannot be evaluated as a prerequisite.

required.description: Required for this source occurrence's selected deliverable. The plan separately computes reachability.

ordinal.description: Order only where semantic order exists, such as outline containment or authored reference use.

source_locator.description: Restricted original source location used for adjudication. Never emit it in a broad event.

placement_context_record_id.description: Exact source placement occurrence that supplies context to a placement-sensitive relative link or policy.
placement_context_record_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve within the same Institution and exact approved job or resource generation as described.

target_source.description: Typed unresolved source resolver intent with optional layer, occurrence and revision pins.

target_record_id.description: Resolved candidate target inside the same job and plan revision.
target_record_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve within the same Institution and exact approved job or resource generation as described.

external_map_id.description: Reviewed, currently authorized same-institution external target binding used instead of a local record.
external_map_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve within the same Institution and exact approved job or resource generation as described.

target_version_id.description: Exact canonical target revision when pinned after verified resolution. Owner validates the polymorphic kind.

resolution.description: Primary verified resolution or blocking/optional disposition.

issue_id.description: Current same-job issue documenting ambiguous, rejected or missing required resolution.
issue_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve within the same Institution and exact approved job or resource generation as described.

x-invariants: Resolved local edges name exactly one same-plan target record. Resolved external edges name exactly one same-institution authorized external map. Unresolved, ambiguous and rejected edges name neither.
Required resolved dependency must retain an exact approved target version before promotion. No title, guessed path or matching digest silently resolves an edge.
Containment and prerequisite graphs are validated as separate cycle-sensitive relation sets. Ordinary hyperlinks can be reciprocal.
The same source reusable definition can create distinct context-specific edges from distinct placement records. Sharing a target does not merge edge occurrence identity.
Edge order and target baseline are immutable for the current plan. Remediation produces a successor plan and new scope review.
